description: $0.05 USDC on Solana per report - the payment buys one signed multi-hop payment-chain reconciliation report: the submitted hop record set (a parent reference with its cap, plus per-hop payment references with expected fields and per-hop caps) is chain-verified hop by hop with the settlement-evidence/v1 engine, ancestor-cap arithmetic is applied over the submitted caps, and one verdict is returned (CHAIN-SETTLED / CHAIN-UNSETTLED / CHAIN-MISMATCH / CHAIN-CAP-EXCEEDED, named hop, factors per hop). No composite score. Records leg only.

hops.description: 1 to 20 hop records in chain order: {hop_id, signature (the on-chain payment transaction), expected {payTo, amountUnits, memo?}, capUnits (decimal string; this hop's cap)}. Processed against the chain; hop-set content is never stored beyond the ledger's closed field list.

parent.description: The chain parent: {reference (caller-chosen label, echoed never graded), capUnits (decimal string; the ancestor cap over all hops)}.

name: chain_reconcile_reconcile
